glossEn: make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of / constitute an addition
note: make an addition (to); join or combine / constitute an addition。线索：add sth to sth / add to the problem。可作不及物（add to）。
state or say further。线索：I should add that…（插话补充）/ add a footnote。宾语是话语/注释而非实体。

glossEn: make an addition by combining numbers
note: make an addition by combining numbers。线索：add up / add A to B（数学读法）。名词 add 指加法。
